final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.throws AS t, COUNT(*) AS n FROM manager_award m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s AS (SELECT t, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS sh FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - av) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE sh > av
